messages:
rachel: Heads-up — nightly billing for 2026-03-22 produced two draft invoices for NimbusCo and the GPU line was omitted (zeroed). See tiny log extract. :frowning:

igor: batch id?

rachel: bill-run-2026-03-22-2. Log extract below:

```
[2026-03-22T03:02:11Z] run-2: aggregate(metric=gpu_hours) sum=0 tenant=nimbusco
[2026-03-22T03:02:11Z] run-2: split_commitment reserved=0.2 expected=0.75
[2026-03-22T03:02:12Z] invoice-svc: wrote draft id=draft-20401
[2026-03-22T03:02:12Z] invoice-svc: wrote draft id=draft-20402
```

maria: raw usage export shows GPU rows for that window, so aggregator filtered them. Any recent partitioning/ETL changes?

rachel: ops-bot flagged a recent partition key flip (tenant_id -> normalized_customer) in last night's ETL. aggregator emitted "WARN: skipped partition NULL_normalized_customer".

devon: duplicates look like two leaders wrote the same batch. Redis lease had a reconnect at 03:02:10Z. Both workers acquired lease and wrote drafts.

igor: action plan: void draft-20402, patch draft-20401 to add GPU line, revert the partition key change, and add an idempotency hardening for invoice-svc.

maria: I'll run the manual patch once rachel posts the draft payload. Also creating reconciliation job to detect missing GPU lines for reserved customers.

rachel: manual patch commands (sanitized):
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $BILL" https://billing.internal/invoices/draft-20401 > /tmp/draft.json
# GPU charge computed: 168h * $30/hr = $5040
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"invoice_id":"draft-20401","ops":[{"op":"add_line","code":"GPU_HOURS","qty":168,"amount_cents":504000}]}' https://billing.internal/admin/patch
```

ops-bot: Incident BIL-2026-142 created. Severity: P2. Assigned: finance oncall.

rachel: patch applied at 03:15Z, draft-20402 voided. Revert PR created and idempotency task assigned. Closing once reconciliation run shows no drift.
